name: Tartrazine
aliases: E102, tartrazine, FD&C Yellow No. 5, Yellow 5, CI 19140, CI Food Yellow 4, Acid Yellow 23, Food Yellow 4
what_is: A synthetic yellow azo colour used to add or restore colour in foods and known in the United States as FD&C Yellow No. 5.
why_botia: BOTIA flags it because the same colour is identified differently across labelling systems and its permitted uses, certification and warning requirements are jurisdiction-specific.
